issues.quote: "I have no plan B other than continuing my studies at the Academy," Theodore said. "If it were up to me, I'd have left the Academy long ago, Agnes."
And if you stayed at the Academy, you might never have to pay a penny of interest on a debt that grew without end.
from the second circle on, a mage could already work in earnest; from the fourth, though, you could say goodbye to any hope of paying off the debt.
Agnes waited out a pause long enough for the exposition
letting Theodore marinate himself in the unenviable prospects
the Card covered even things like designer clothes and cosy houses
